subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should maintainers accept the current-run private transcript successful-terminal-turn predicate as the recovery boundary for the Agent Teams lost-context/output mismatch?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it intentionally changes stale subagent lifecycle and parent-delivery semantics, so a maintainer needs to own the recovery boundary and exact-head readiness decision.

options.title: Proceed With Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: Accept the bounded session-state risk after exact-head validation because this branch follows the maintainer-stated private transcript/status direction.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for live Agent Teams or Gateway proof that loses context mid-run before accepting the lifecycle recovery predicate.

options.title: Keep Error-Only Recovery
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers decide lost-context recovery must not infer success from private transcript terminal turns.

recommendation.title: Proceed With Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded session-state risk after exact-head validation because this branch follows the maintainer-stated private transcript/status direction.
